name: @sellerops/contracts
description: Shared SellerOps contracts (Action Window, session readiness, acquisition, review-import journey). ESM TypeScript source consumed by the collector (tsx/vitest), the frontend (vite), and type-checked by tsc. Declared `type: module` so `export *` barrels re-export as real ESM named exports at runtime (a CJS load turns `export *` into a dynamic re-export whose names static imports cannot see).
